text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I climbed a mountain famous 
around here... and the scenery was 
something you can only enjoy there!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The sun makes the buildings sparkle and 
shine. And at night, the city turns into a 
sea of jewels...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"You must come along next time, Trainer! 
Eating haskap berries at the mountain 
summit is simply the best!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Hokko Tarumae was able to spend 
a fulfilling day off!
